# Mary Stubbs & Winifred Tolley

- [Winifred Tolley](../character/winifred-tolley.md) — Commands — [Mary Stubbs](../character/mary-stubbs.md) — employer or household authority lecturing her on behavior · since v5  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER XXIII. THE GOOD-CONDUCT CLUB P38](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0038), [v5 CHAPTER XXV. ANOTHER SCANDAL AND ANOTHER “EXPLANATION” P12](../source/v05-c25.md#nw-v05-c25-p0012), [v5 CHAPTER XXXI. ## Shared scenes

> [Tessa Carrow](../character/tessa-carrow.md) is tasked with carrying a basket of strawberries to the manse, but [Mary Stubbs](../character/mary-stubbs.md) harasses and chases her through the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) street with a dried codfish. Miss Winifred rescues the terrified [Tessa](../character/tessa-carrow.md) and returns her home, where Miss Winifred, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), and [Tabitha](../character/tabitha.md) discuss Mary's wild behavior, the local children, and potential wives for the minister.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER VII. A FISHY EPISODE

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER VII. A FISHY EPISODE P0](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0000), [v5 CHAPTER VII. A FISHY EPISODE P14](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0014), [v5 CHAPTER VII. A FISHY EPISODE P16](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0016), [v5 CHAPTER VII. A FISHY EPISODE P19](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0019)_

> Miss Winifred interrogates Mary at the manse and later updates [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Tabitha](../character/tabitha.md) after learning that Mrs. [Grimble](../character/grimble.md) has died. Meanwhile, the children gather at [Fern Hollow](../codex/places.md#fern-hollow), where Edmund reads myths and imagines the Pied Piper leading them away. [Bess](../character/bess-carrow.md) arrives with news of Mrs. Grimble's death, startling Mary, but [Ida](../character/ida-ashdown.md) reassures her and promises to pray that Mary can remain in [Seven Gulls](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls).
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER VIII. MISS WINIFRED INTERVENES

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER VIII. MISS WINIFRED INTERVENES P0](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0000), [v5 CHAPTER VIII. MISS WINIFRED INTERVENES P8](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0008), [v5 CHAPTER VIII. MISS WINIFRED INTERVENES P12](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0012), [v5 CHAPTER VIII. MISS WINIFRED INTERVENES P39](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0039)_

> Miss Winifred urges Mr. Ashdown to address Mary's upbringing, leading Mr. Ashdown to speak warmly with the girl. Driven by Mary's impending return to the asylum, [Ida](../character/ida-ashdown.md) visits Miss Winifred to ask if she will take Mary in. After consulting her husband [Ambrose](../character/ambrose.md), Miss Winifred agrees to adopt Mary, and the children give Mary farewell gifts.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER IX. IDA INTERVENES

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER IX. IDA INTERVENES P5](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0005), [v5 CHAPTER IX. IDA INTERVENES P17](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0017), [v5 CHAPTER IX. > Mary informs [Grace](../character/grace.md) and [Ida](../character/ida-ashdown.md) that they caused a scandal in the community by doing household chores on Sunday after getting their days mixed up. [Grace](../character/grace.md) laughs off the mistake once she realizes how the days were miscounted, reassuring [Ida](../character/ida-ashdown.md) that she has a plan to clarify everything to the town.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER XI. A DREADFUL DISCOVERY

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XI. A DREADFUL DISCOVERY P0](../source/v05-c11.md#nw-v05-c11-p0000), [v5 CHAPTER XI. A DREADFUL DISCOVERY P10](../source/v05-c11.md#nw-v05-c11-p0010), [v5 CHAPTER XI. > Miss Winifred and [Tabitha](../character/tabitha.md) visit [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) at [Hollowmere](../codex/places.md#hollowmere) to discuss Myra Murray's funeral and church gossip. They debate the nature of the afterlife and discuss various church members, including Mrs. [Hector](../character/hector.md) Twiss's threat to withhold her subscription, before sending [Mary Stubbs](../character/mary-stubbs.md) to [Fern Hollow](../codex/places.md#fern-hollow), where she tells [Grace Ashdown](../character/grace.md) about the potential financial troubles facing her father's parish.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER XV. MORE GOSSIP

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XV. MORE GOSSIP P0](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0000), [v5 CHAPTER XV. MORE GOSSIP P9](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0009), [v5 CHAPTER XV. MORE GOSSIP P23](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0023), [v5 CHAPTER XV. MORE GOSSIP P34](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0034)_

> Miss Winifred dismisses [Mary Stubbs](../character/mary-stubbs.md) after her knitting, and Mary runs to [Fern Hollow](../codex/places.md#fern-hollow) to share news with [Grace Ashdown](../character/grace.md) about [Kitty Hector](../character/twiss.md) and the Fairlies' threats to force Grace's father out. [Grace](../character/grace.md) despairs over the thought of having to leave the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen), but while looking out her bedroom window at night, she hatches a plan to visit [Lionel Fairlie](../character/lionel-fairlie.md) and fix the problem herself.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER XV. MORE GOSSIP

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XV. MORE GOSSIP P33](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0033), [v5 CHAPTER XV. MORE GOSSIP P34](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0034), [v5 CHAPTER XV. MORE GOSSIP P35](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0035), [v5 CHAPTER XV. MORE GOSSIP P38](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0038)_

> [Grace](../character/grace.md) scandalizes the congregation by wearing boots without stockings to church, drawing sharp criticism from local gossips while [Tabitha](../character/tabitha.md) and the Carrow girls rush to her defense. To protect her father's reputation and fulfill a punishment imposed by Tobias, [Grace](../character/grace.md) publishes an explanatory letter in the local newspaper detailing why she gave away her last good stockings.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER XXV. ANOTHER SCANDAL AND ANOTHER “EXPLANATION”

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XXV. ANOTHER SCANDAL AND ANOTHER “EXPLANATION” P0](../source/v05-c25.md#nw-v05-c25-p0000), [v5 CHAPTER XXV. > While spending a pleasant spring evening at [Fern Hollow](../codex/places.md#fern-hollow), the children share their dreams for the future until [Mary Stubbs](../character/mary-stubbs.md) arrives and startles them with a ghost story about [Henry Warren](../character/henry-warren.md) and the nearby ruined [Bailey](../codex/places.md#bailey) property. After Mary cooks trout for the group, darkness falls and the lingering terror forces [Grace](../character/grace.md), [Ida](../character/ida-ashdown.md), and [Rupert](../character/rupert.md) to head home together, carefully avoiding the old garden.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER XXIX. A WEIRD TALE

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XXIX. A WEIRD TALE P0](../source/v05-c29.md#nw-v05-c29-p0000), [v5 CHAPTER XXIX. A WEIRD TALE P1](../source/v05-c29.md#nw-v05-c29-p0001), [v5 CHAPTER XXIX. A WEIRD TALE P9](../source/v05-c29.md#nw-v05-c29-p0009), [v5 CHAPTER XXIX. A WEIRD TALE P14](../source/v05-c29.md#nw-v05-c29-p0014)_

> Tobias punishes [Rupert](../character/rupert.md) for running away from a ghost by forcing him to sit on a graveyard tombstone until midnight. [Rupert](../character/rupert.md) endures the chilly rain during his midnight vigil and subsequently falls gravely ill with double pneumonia. After a tense battle for his life, [Rupert](../character/rupert.md) recovers with the support of the community and returns to [Fern Hollow](../codex/places.md#fern-hollow).
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER XXXI. RUPERT DOES PENANCE

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Miss Winifred discuss the upcoming marriages of [Clementine](../character/clementine-ainslie.md) Ashdown and [Harriet Ainslie](../character/harriet-ainslie.md), as well as plans for the minister's children while he is away. Meanwhile, the local children gather outdoors on Kit's final night before leaving for Regent's [Academy](../codex/places.md#regent-s-academy), where Edmund imagines the Pied Piper calling the boys away to follow him.
>
